# Contributing to Lightning-UQ-Box

We welcome bug fixes, documentation improvements, and new features and methods.
Please read the [Contribution Guide](https://lightning-uq-box.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contribute.html)
for development setup, testing, and documentation instructions.

All contributions must follow our [AI contribution policy](../AI_POLICY.md).
AI assistance is permitted, but a human must review and understand the changes
before submission. Fully autonomous contributions are not accepted.
